name: SIREN HEAD: LEGACY
desc:
Siren Head is a 40-foot-tall humanoid creature with a heavily emaciated, near-skeletal frame covered in dried, mummified flesh the color of rusty metal. We have located its position to be on an island with no population. Containment of the island has been succesful and project "DISTRACTION" has been approved. We will begin populating the island with prisoners and futher studies on the creature will be conducted.

- All characters creatively belong to "Trever Henderson".
- Voice lines are from "David Near".

llm.loop: survive on an island while a giant Siren Head hunts players; spend cash on guns, drones and special characters
llm.objectives: survive Siren Head and other monsters
llm.progression: cash from survival, gun shop, character passes
llm.instructions: join the prisoner island, survive the creature
unique: become-the-monster passes (Siren Head, Megahorn, Cartoon Cat, Bridge Worm) mixing Trevor Henderson creatures
llm.thumbnails: Siren Head silhouette and foggy forest, no text
llm.complexity_notes: large map, monster AI, multiple morph characters, guns
